title: Multi Site Environmental Manager, Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP)
description:
Multi Site Environmental Manager, Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP)

Brazil's Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team is seeking a Multi Site Environmental Manager (MSEM) to support our Amazon Operations. This role supports multiple sites. The MSEM will develop standards and policies to support regulatory compliance as well as partner with operations leadership teams for execution of these standards and policies, to ensure compliance with all applicable county/locations specific Federal, State and local laws and regulations. The MSEM travels greater than 50% of the time.

Key job responsibilities

  • Manage and execute multi site responsibilities to comply with stormwater, waste, wastewater and other environmental related laws, regulations and permits. This includes required Federal, State and local reporting.
  • Manage and execute business conformance with Amazon EAP Management Systems Policies. Develop Amazon Geo-Specific Operational Environmental Procedures by integrating with engineering, construction and operations.
  • Lead regulatory agency interactions, permit evaluation and processing, and new process and technology introduction.
  • Primary point of contact for environmental regulatory agencies and represents Amazon at appropriate levels with governmental agencies and throughout the company.
  • Ensure work performed by contractors, consultants, and employees is completed in accordance with regulatory requirements and Amazon standards.
  • Monitor environmental metrics to review trends to determine where improvements are needed.
  • Conduct thorough and accurate environmental inspections and audits for continuous improvement.
  • Prioritize and manage multiple, technically complex assignments, concurrently.
  • Build and manage collaborative relationships with various stakeholders to ensure risks are identified early and managed appropriately.
  • Compile and submit time critical reports to various governmental agencies.
  • Complete thorough and accurate environmental incident investigations and associated regulatory reports, and develop appropriate corrective actions.
  • Ensure site leadership and associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy.

A day in the life

The MSEM will complete environmental performance analysis, establish and monitor metrics, and guide the operations leadership teams in implementation of Amazon environmental standards. The MSEM will work with internal and external partners that include government entities, contractors, consultants, design, construction, operations and other key stakeholders.

About the team

The EAP organization protects Amazon businesses and supports the needs of our customers by proactively mitigating environmental regulatory risks and protecting the environment.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in the Environmental Sciences, Environmental Engineering, or related field
  • Experience developing and implementing environmental compliance programs including regulated waste, water, and air regulations in accordance with applicable laws
  • Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience engaging with regulatory agencies in permit applications or equivalent
  • Experience in environmental compliance and permitting, waste management, contractual, regulatory, and liability assessments, environmental permit evaluations and applications, EIAs and water discharge requirements
  • Knowledge of Brazilian state and federal environmental regulations

title: Corporate Communications Senior Manager
description:
Corporate Communications Senior Manager

Department: Communications

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Corporate Communications Senior Manager will lead strategic planning and delivery of communications and public relations strategies and activities for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring the tournament is powerfully positioned in line with FIFA’s overall strategic objectives and the FIFA Women’s Football Strategy.

This role is responsible to support the Head of Communications & Media Relations in the rollout and implementation of the Communications components of the tournament’s Marketing & Communications Strategy, with a strong focus on Brazil and South America. The position plays a central role in leading the development and implementation of proactive corporate communications that enhance FIFA’s reputation, raises awareness on the tournament, influences public perception, engages with internal and external stakeholders for higher impact and ensures consistency across proactive and reactive messaging at a global level.

Reporting jointly to the Head of Communications & Media Relations based in Brazil and to the Team Lead Corporate Communications in Switzerland, the Corporate Communications Senior Manager will collaborates with senior stakeholders, decision-makers, and leadership teams to translate corporate priorities and tournament objectives into engaging, credible narratives.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and implement a corporate communications-first approach, delivering proactive, strategic messaging and storytelling across Brazil and South America in line with the Marketing & Communications Strategy.
  • Develops messaging for tournament milestones, events, initiatives, campaigns, announcements and key FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ functional areas.
  • Act as the central integrator for communications-related matters, coordinating internal and external stakeholders including FIFA27 functional teams, Host City communications teams, federal, state and municipal authorities, the CBF, and other key partners.
  • Develop and implement pre‑emptive communications plans to manage risk, address sensitive topics and engage targeted audiences.
  • Develop issues and crisis communications planning and execution within FIFA27 in close alignment with the FIFA Communications Division, supporting all relevant partners and activities in the lead‑up to and during the tournament.
  • Build close working relationships with other Marketing and Communications teams to ensure narrative unity and operational efficiency.
  • Partner with the Media Relations department to identify and amplify proactive stories that shape public understanding of FIFA’s initiatives.
  • Partner with digital, editorial, and campaign teams to deliver integrated storytelling across FIFA’s ecosystem,
  • Perform other duties directly related to the role, as required by FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ leadership or the FIFA Communications Division.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 7 years experience in communications, media and public relations, with experience in similar leadership positions
  • Familiarity with the world of football. Passion for women’s football is a plus
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written) and Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Spanish language skills are an asset
  • Able and willing to travel up to 50% of the year
  • Able and willing to work non‑traditional hours including evenings and weekends as needed
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Ad Ops Onboarding Manager - Publishers (Remote)
description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, seen by 300M+ people monthly. For 16 years, we’ve achieved double-digit growth by blending proprietary AI technology with manual optimization techniques to empower publishers. We are a culture-centric, location-independent organization that values Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen, and Collaboration.

MonetizeMore offers location and schedule freedom to every one of its team members. That means that you would have the lifestyle autonomy to choose to work from anywhere in the world, during the time of day you prefer. This new-age work lifestyle would enable you to engineer your ideal lifestyle. Say goodbye to endless commutes, stuffy business attire, and the arbitrary 9 to 5 work-day. Take your life back into your hands by joining the MonetizeMore team!

What You’ll Do

As part of our Publisher Centric Team , At M2, we focus and emphasize proactive Publisher Services. As the Onboarding Manager, your role is a critical "first impression" of our organization and our ability to support our publishing partners in reaching their goals.

You will spearhead the onboarding process for new publishers, ensuring they are equipped with the right tech, knowledge, and confidence to succeed. You are not just setting up accounts you are orchestrating a "White Glove" experience that reduces time-to-value and sets the stage for long-term retention. You also pay attention to improving our systems and processes along the way to continuously improve our service to publishers.

Responsibilities

  1. Project Management & Implementation
    • Lead the Lifecycle: Expertly manage the publisher journey from Sales endorsement to "Live" status. You are the project manager for the publisher’s first 30-90 days.
    • Technical Coordination: Collaborate with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to troubleshoot setup concerns (Header Bidding, GAM, wrappers) and ensure optimal configuration.
    • Feature Activation: Ensure all applicable M2 Tech Features are activated at launch to maximize publisher revenue immediately (KPI: Uptake %).
  2. Client-Centric Communication & Education
    • Kick-off & Strategy: Conduct kick-off calls to understand the publisher's specific business goals and align our implementation plan to meet them.
    • Ambassadorship: Act as the primary champion for M2 tools and products. Provide comprehensive walkthroughs to ensure publishers are comfortable and proficient with our platform.
    • Responsive Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for all questions during installation, providing guidance that is both technical and empathetic.
  3. Performance Analysis & Handoff
    • Performance Reviews: Conduct thorough 7-day and 30-day post-live performance reviews. Use data to demonstrate value and identify early optimization wins.
    • Seamless Transition: Manage a structured handoff to the Ad Optimizer and Customer Success Manager, ensuring no momentum is lost after the initial 30-day period.

Day-today Activities

You are the external face of MonetizeMore for our newest partners. You thrive on variety and high-energy interaction—no two days (or publishers) are exactly alike.

  • External Engagement: You will constantly meet new partners, leading high-impact kickoff calls to align our tech with their specific business goals.
  • Project Command: You project manage the entire implementation lifecycle, coordinating between the publisher and our technical teams to ensure an optimal, revenue-ready setup and accelerated scale.
  • Performance Ownership: You don't just "set it and forget it." You conduct data-driven 7-day and 30-day etc. performance reviews to prove value immediately.
  • Seamless Handoff: Once the foundation is solid, you orchestrate a smooth transfer to the account management team ensuring the relationship momentum continues uninterrupted.

How this role fits into the organization

This is a cornerstone role that is pivotal to our company’s success.

  • Strategic Impact: Reporting to the Ad Ops Team Manager, you are the architect of the "First 30 Days." Since our publishers' growth is our growth, our long-term revenue goals effectively start on your desk.
  • The "Wow" Factor: You are responsible for delivering the "White Glove" experience. You set the trajectory for retention by uncovering publisher goals early and proving that MonetizeMore is a partner, not just a vendor.
  • Bridge Builder: You act as the vital link between Sales promises and long-term Operational success, ensuring that every new client enters our ecosystem with clarity, confidence, and a setup primed for revenue generation.

Who You Are

Must Haves

  • Experience: 1+ years of experience in Programmatic sell-side advertising, Customer Onboarding, or Ad Operations.
  • Technical Knowledge: Understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM), AdSense, Header Bidding, and Google Analytics. Experience with WordPress and debugging ad calls is a strong plus.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data presentation tools. You can spot trends in numbers quickly.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You can command a room (virtually) and manage expectations clearly.
  • Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple implementations simultaneously without dropping the ball.

Nice to Have

  • Has worked with AdSense, Google Analytics, and GAM and has extensive knowledge of Google policies and other platforms
  • Understands coding and has a strong tech background
  • Has worked with WordPress and is knowledgeable when it comes to implementing ads and debugging ad calls
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and Spanish are an extra bonus

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary : Our salary formula adjusts to your cost of living and experience.
  • Work remotely : Live and work wherever you like!
  • Flexible working hours : You have the autonomy to set your own schedule
  • Retreats : We meet in person for company get-togethers.
  • Career growth and learning opportunities

If you think you are a good fit to join our Ad Optimization , please apply on this side bar and give specific reasons what sets you apart. We hire individuals, not robots so don’t be afraid to show a little personality.

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion. Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

Reporting organizationally to the Senior Telecoms Manager, the Network Manager (NWM) will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team. Ensure regular reporting to the Local Entity’s management and maintain clear and efficient communication with all functional areas and external partners.

description:
Descrição e Responsabilidades

PRINCÍPIOS E CULTURA DE SALVAGUARDA

MSF está em busca de pessoas que compartilhem do compromisso com uma cultura de salvaguarda, que visa garantir um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Em MSF, não toleramos qualquer forma de abuso ou comportamento inadequado, seja em relação a colegas de trabalho, pacientes, doadores ou qualquer outra parte envolvida nas nossas operações.

Além disso, buscamos promover e garantir a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações e práticas. Assim, fortalecemos nossa missão e asseguramos que todas as pessoas tenham a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer na organização. Candidaturas que demonstrem alinhamento com esses valores serão altamente valorizadas.

Alinhada com os valores que orientam as ações da nossa organização em todo o mundo, priorizaremos a candidatura de pessoas que cumpram os requisitos estabelecidos e se identifiquem com um ou mais grupos minorizados, sendo eles: Pessoas Negras (Pretas e Pardas), Indígenas, Trans, PcD e pessoas com mais de 40 anos.

CONTEXTO DA VAGA

A captação de novas pessoas doadoras para a organização é o principal recurso para que possamos atuar nos mais diversos contextos de ajuda médica humanitária ao redor do mundo. Dessa forma, as equipes de captação de recursos são fundamentais para que essa atuação seja realizada, pois é através delas, que se vincula financeiramente novas pessoas a nossa causa.

COMO É SER UMA PESSOA CAPTADORA DE RECURSOS EM MSF-BRASIL:

Trabalhar com Captação de Recursos em Médicos Sem Fronteiras é muito mais do que abordar pessoas nas ruas — é ser a ponte entre a organização e aquelas que tornam nosso trabalho possível: as pessoas doadoras.

Diariamente, você estará 100% nas ruas de Rio de Janeiro e região metropolitana , abordando ativamente as pessoas para apresentar a missão de MSF e convidá-las a se tornarem doadoras. O trabalho envolve conversar diretamente com o público, explicar o impacto da organização, contornar objeções e garantir novas adesões. Cada abordagem é uma oportunidade de transformar um simples encontro em um ato concreto de apoio às emergências médicas ao redor do mundo.

É um trabalho dinâmico, onde cada dia traz novos desafios e aprendizados. O ambiente é sempre coletivo, repleto de troca com a equipe, compartilhamento de experiências e muita energia. Para brilhar nessa função, é essencial gostar de interagir, ser uma pessoa resiliente, comunicativa, carismática e persistente. Afinal, cada novo doação conquistada representa um impacto real na vida de quem mais precisa.

Se você busca um trabalho com propósito, movimento e desafios diários, essa vaga é para você!

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Atuando em funções como:

  • Atuar como ponto focal de contato técnico para cibersegurança de OT em todas as operações FPSO, garantindo a conformidade com a governança da empresa, as políticas da MODEC e as normas (IEC 62443, NIST CSF, ISO 27019, IEC 61511).

  • Realizar avaliações de vulnerabilidade e gerir atividades de aplicação de patches, equilibrando a continuidade operacional, a segurança do sistema e os riscos de cibersegurança.
  • Implementar e monitorar controles de criptografia, gestão de chaves e backup/recuperação; validar a continuidade dos negócios e a prontidão para recuperação de desastres por meio de testes regulares.
  • Apoiar investigações de incidentes e análises de causa raiz (RCA) para eventos relacionados com OT ou cibersegurança, garantindo que ações corretivas e preventivas sejam implementadas.
  • Executar atividades de conformidade, garantia e auditoria, mantendo evidências para certificação IEC 62443, governança corporativa e inspeções regulatórias.
  • Preparar e apresentar relatórios de desempenho de cibersegurança (KPIs, incidentes, status de conformidade) aos proprietários de ativos, OIM e cibersegurança OT corporativa.
  • Coordenar com operações, manutenção, TI, fornecedores e segurança corporativa para garantir a integração segura de OT-IT e intervenções de fornecedores em conformidade.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de digitalização e Indústria 4.0, garantindo que os controles de cibersegurança estejam incorporados em plataformas de computação de ponta, IoT e análise de dados.
  • Monitorar ameaças emergentes, segurança Zero-Trust e padrões em evolução para melhorar continuamente a resiliência da cibersegurança do FPSO.
  • Impulsionar a melhoria contínua dos procedimentos de cibersegurança OT, capacidades de deteção e documentação de governança.
  • Participar em revisões de arquitetura, design de controle e avaliações de segurança para implementações da Indústria 4.0.
  • Garantir que os controles de cibersegurança sejam incorporados por design em todas as novas tecnologias digitais implementadas em ambientes OT.
  • Garantir que as operações ROC e os projetos de digitalização estejam em conformidade com os padrões da indústria (por exemplo, IEC 62443, NIST CSF) e as políticas corporativas de cibersegurança.
  • Manter a supervisão do monitoramento remoto, alertas e resposta a incidentes para garantir operações seguras e confiáveis.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de segurança funcional e responsáveis pelo SIS para alinhar os riscos de cibersegurança, de modo que não comprometam os níveis de integridade de segurança (SIL).
  • Promover a consciencialização cibernética entre o pessoal de operações e manutenção, enfatizando práticas seguras para manutenção, desvio e gestão de substituição do SIS.

  • Engenharia Elétricae áreas relacionadas (Engenharia de Controlo e Automação, Engenharia Informática, Engenharia de Telecomunicações, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Mecatrónica, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia de Redes de Comunicação);

title: Onboarding Manager - Publishers (Remote)
description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, seen by 300M+ people monthly. For 16 years, we’ve achieved double-digit growth by blending proprietary AI technology with manual optimization techniques to empower publishers. We are a culture-centric, location-independent organization that values Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen, and Collaboration.

MonetizeMore offers location and schedule freedom to every one of its team members. That means that you would have the lifestyle autonomy to choose to work from anywhere in the world, during the time of day you prefer. This new-age work lifestyle would enable you to engineer your ideal lifestyle. Say goodbye to endless commutes, stuffy business attire, and the arbitrary 9 to 5 work-day. Take your life back into your hands by joining the MonetizeMore team!

What You’ll Do

As part of our Publisher Centric Team , At M2, we focus and emphasize proactive Publisher Services. As the Onboarding Manager, your role is a critical "first impression" of our organization and our ability to support our publishing partners in reaching their goals.

You will spearhead the onboarding process for new publishers, ensuring they are equipped with the right tech, knowledge, and confidence to succeed. You are not just setting up accounts you are orchestrating a "White Glove" experience that reduces time-to-value and sets the stage for long-term retention. You also pay attention to improving our systems and processes along the way to continuously improve our service to publishers.

Responsibilities

  1. Project Management & Implementation
    • Lead the Lifecycle: Expertly manage the publisher journey from Sales endorsement to "Live" status. You are the project manager for the publisher’s first 30-90 days.
    • Technical Coordination: Collaborate with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to troubleshoot setup concerns (Header Bidding, GAM, wrappers) and ensure optimal configuration.
    • Feature Activation: Ensure all applicable M2 Tech Features are activated at launch to maximize publisher revenue immediately (KPI: Uptake %).
  2. Client-Centric Communication & Education
    • Kick-off & Strategy: Conduct kick-off calls to understand the publisher's specific business goals and align our implementation plan to meet them.
    • Ambassadorship: Act as the primary champion for M2 tools and products. Provide comprehensive walkthroughs to ensure publishers are comfortable and proficient with our platform.
    • Responsive Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for all questions during installation, providing guidance that is both technical and empathetic.
  3. Performance Analysis & Handoff
    • Performance Reviews: Conduct thorough 7-day and 30-day post-live performance reviews. Use data to demonstrate value and identify early optimization wins.
    • Seamless Transition: Manage a structured handoff to the Ad Optimizer and Customer Success Manager, ensuring no momentum is lost after the initial 30-day period.

Day-today Activities

You are the external face of MonetizeMore for our newest partners. You thrive on variety and high-energy interaction—no two days (or publishers) are exactly alike.

  • External Engagement: You will constantly meet new partners, leading high-impact kickoff calls to align our tech with their specific business goals.
  • Project Command: You project manage the entire implementation lifecycle, coordinating between the publisher and our technical teams to ensure an optimal, revenue-ready setup and accelerated scale.
  • Performance Ownership: You don't just "set it and forget it." You conduct data-driven 7-day and 30-day etc. performance reviews to prove value immediately.
  • Seamless Handoff: Once the foundation is solid, you orchestrate a smooth transfer to the account management team ensuring the relationship momentum continues uninterrupted.

How this role fits into the organization

This is a cornerstone role that is pivotal to our company’s success.

  • Strategic Impact: Reporting to the Ad Ops Team Manager, you are the architect of the "First 30 Days." Since our publishers' growth is our growth, our long-term revenue goals effectively start on your desk.
  • The "Wow" Factor: You are responsible for delivering the "White Glove" experience. You set the trajectory for retention by uncovering publisher goals early and proving that MonetizeMore is a partner, not just a vendor.
  • Bridge Builder: You act as the vital link between Sales promises and long-term Operational success, ensuring that every new client enters our ecosystem with clarity, confidence, and a setup primed for revenue generation.

Who You Are

Must Haves

  • Experience: 1+ years of experience in Programmatic sell-side advertising, Customer Onboarding, or Ad Operations.
  • Technical Knowledge: Understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM), AdSense, Header Bidding, and Google Analytics. Experience with WordPress and debugging ad calls is a strong plus.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data presentation tools. You can spot trends in numbers quickly.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You can command a room (virtually) and manage expectations clearly.
  • Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple implementations simultaneously without dropping the ball.

Nice to Have

  • Has worked with AdSense, Google Analytics, and GAM and has extensive knowledge of Google policies and other platforms
  • Understands coding and has a strong tech background
  • Has worked with WordPress and is knowledgeable when it comes to implementing ads and debugging ad calls
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and Spanish are an extra bonus

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary : Our salary formula adjusts to your cost of living and experience.
  • Work remotely : Live and work wherever you like!
  • Flexible working hours : You have the autonomy to set your own schedule
  • Retreats : We meet in person for company get-togethers.
  • Career growth and learning opportunities

If you think you are a good fit to join our Ad Optimization , please apply on this side bar and give specific reasons what sets you apart. We hire individuals, not robots so don’t be afraid to show a little personality.

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion. Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

title: ESPECIALISTA EM CIBERSEGURANÇA OT / OT Cybersecurity Specialist
description:
Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Estamos em busca de profissionais de Cibersegurança para atuar em nosso escritório no Flamengo , RJ.

A posição tem foco em garantir a cibersegurança, segurança, integridade, disponibilidade e confiabilidade de todos os sistemas de Tecnologia Operacional (OT) que suportam as operações da FPSO, alinhando a cibersegurança com a governança corporativa, os requisitos marítimos/de classe e as normas internacionais, tais como IEC 62443, IEC 61511, NIST CSF e ISO 27001.

Atuando em funções como:

  • Atuar como ponto focal de contato técnico para cibersegurança de OT em todas as operações FPSO, garantindo a conformidade com a governança da empresa, as políticas da MODEC e as normas (IEC 62443, NIST CSF, ISO 27019, IEC 61511).
  • Manter e atualizar o inventário de ativos OT (controladores, HMIs, servidores, sistemas de segurança, dispositivos de rede) e suas respectivas configurações; controlar e documentar todas as alterações de configuração e software.
  • Gerir os processos de controle de alterações dos equipamentos de OT (MOC), garantindo que os impactos na cibersegurança e segurança sejam avaliados, validados e autorizados antes da implementação.
  • Administrar e manter redes OT e infraestrutura de segurança, incluindo firewalls, IDS/IPS, zonas/conduítes e gateways para garantir segmentação, desempenho e conformidade.
  • Supervisionar a gestão do controle de acesso para usuários, serviços e dispositivos; aplicar o princípio do privilégio mínimo, auditar registos de acesso e controlar o acesso remoto de fornecedores e o uso de dispositivos móveis como pen drives, HDs, SSD, etc.
  • Realizar monitoramento contínuo de eventos e alertas de cibersegurança; coordenar detecção, resposta e restauração de incidentes alinhados com cibersegurança global de IT e OT Global, SOC e procedimentos offshore dos Técnicos de Sistemas.
  • Realizar avaliações de vulnerabilidade e gerir atividades de aplicação de patches, equilibrando a continuidade operacional, a segurança do sistema e os riscos de cibersegurança.
  • Implementar e monitorar controles de criptografia, gestão de chaves e backup/recuperação; validar a continuidade dos negócios e a prontidão para recuperação de desastres por meio de testes regulares.
  • Apoiar investigações de incidentes e análises de causa raiz (RCA) para eventos relacionados com OT ou cibersegurança, garantindo que ações corretivas e preventivas sejam implementadas.
  • Executar atividades de conformidade, garantia e auditoria, mantendo evidências para certificação IEC 62443, governança corporativa e inspeções regulatórias.
  • Preparar e apresentar relatórios de desempenho de cibersegurança (KPIs, incidentes, status de conformidade) aos proprietários de ativos, OIM e cibersegurança OT corporativa.
  • Coordenar com operações, manutenção, TI, fornecedores e segurança corporativa para garantir a integração segura de OT-IT e intervenções de fornecedores em conformidade.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de digitalização e Indústria 4.0, garantindo que os controles de cibersegurança estejam incorporados em plataformas de computação de ponta, IoT e análise de dados.
  • Monitorar ameaças emergentes, segurança Zero-Trust e padrões em evolução para melhorar continuamente a resiliência da cibersegurança do FPSO.
  • Impulsionar a melhoria contínua dos procedimentos de cibersegurança OT, capacidades de deteção e documentação de governança.
  • Participar em revisões de arquitetura, design de controle e avaliações de segurança para implementações da Indústria 4.0.
  • Garantir que os controles de cibersegurança sejam incorporados por design em todas as novas tecnologias digitais implementadas em ambientes OT.
  • Garantir que as operações ROC e os projetos de digitalização estejam em conformidade com os padrões da indústria (por exemplo, IEC 62443, NIST CSF) e as políticas corporativas de cibersegurança.
  • Manter a supervisão do monitoramento remoto, alertas e resposta a incidentes para garantir operações seguras e confiáveis.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de segurança funcional e responsáveis pelo SIS para alinhar os riscos de cibersegurança, de modo que não comprometam os níveis de integridade de segurança (SIL).
  • Promover a consciencialização cibernética entre o pessoal de operações e manutenção, enfatizando práticas seguras para manutenção, desvio e gestão de substituição do SIS.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

Formação e Certificações

  • Engenharia Elétricae áreas relacionadas (Engenharia de Controlo e Automação, Engenharia Informática, Engenharia de Telecomunicações, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Mecatrónica, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia de Redes de Comunicação);
  • Ciência da Computação; Sistemas de Informação, e outras formações relacionadas à área.
  • Inglês avançado.

Certificações preferenciais

  • Especialista ou Perito em Cibersegurança ISA/IEC 62443;
  • Engenheiro de Segurança Funcional (diferencial);
  • Cursos de cibersegurança ICS/SCADA de OEM/fornecedores com experiência prática.

description:
Descrição da vaga

O profissional atuará no desenvolvimento de projetos de consultoria em Supply Chain, diagnosticando problemas complexos e implementando soluções inovadoras que visam gerar transformações significativas, ganhos de eficiência e otimização de custos nas estratégias de negócio e operações dos clientes.

Sua atuação abrangerá diversas frentes críticas da cadeia de suprimentos, incluindo Planejamento de Demanda e Estoques, Planejamento Integrado (S&OP/IBP), Logística e Malha de Distribuição, Contratações Estratégicas e Compras Transacionais, Gestão de Armazenagem e Tecnologia associados.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Suportar na liderança das frentes de trabalho e temas específicos dos projetos de consultoria em Supply Chain.
  • Realizar diagnósticos aprofundados para compreender o cenário atual do Supply Chain e identificar criticamente as principais lacunas em todas as suas dimensões.
  • Conduzir a coleta, análise aprofundada de dados (quantitativos e qualitativos) e diagnóstico de GAPs e oportunidades.
  • Desenvolver hipóteses, modelar cenários e estruturar recomendações estratégicas e táticas.
  • Implementar as melhorias identificadas nas dimensões de estratégia, normativos, processos, pessoas e tecnologia.
  • Elaborar e apresentar materiais e relatórios de status e resultados para stakeholders do cliente e liderança interna.
  • Atuar na gestão de atividades do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e a qualidade das entregas.
  • Apoiar na gestão de Projetos no planejamento e controle geral do projeto.
  • Interagir diretamente com equipes do cliente em diversos níveis hierárquicos.
  • Realizar treinamentos nos diversos temas relacionados a supply chain.
  • Mentorar e orientar analistas mais juniores da equipe.
  • Colaborar na formulação de propostas técnicas estratégicas, apoiando o setor comercial no fechamento de novos negócios
  • Desenvolver, suportar e/ou implementar funcionalmente ferramentas e soluções tecnológicas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Educação superior completa em Engenharia, Logística, Administração, Ciência de Dados ou áreas afins
  • Experiência profissional em diversificadas áreas da cadeia de suprimentos
  • Desejável experiência em Projetos e empresa de Consultoria em Supply Chain
  • Conhecimento de Excel, Access e Power Point (avançados), SQL e Power BI
  • Desejável conhecimento de sistemas ERPs (conceitual)
  • Desejável conhecimento em Python, R ou outras linguagens de programação
  • Inglês intermediário

Informações adicionais

Habilidades comportamentais

  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Organização e gestão do tempo;
  • Trabalho em equipe e colaboração;
  • Resolução de problemas;
  • Gestão de conflitos;
  • Proatividade e iniciativa.

title: Senior
description:
Senior Staff Engineer, Investments Platforms

The Opportunity:

This position is for an Senior Staff Software Engineer to join theInvestments Business Unit.

Investments Platforms is responsible for the core platforms that model Nubank’s investments business: custody, offer, order management, accounts, settlement and related domains. These platforms are the long‑term home for our investments capabilities and the main path to move away from legacy Invest systems that still handle a large portion of critical flows today. Your mandate is to help design, evolve and execute this environment and comply with regulatory requirements.

About Nubank's Engineering Culture:

We believe in small, empowered teams, a process‑light environment and a culture of ownership, learning and collaboration. Our architecture is platform‑oriented: we build extensible, agnostic business platforms (e.g., payments, banking, investments) that can be reused across products, markets and asset classes. You will be expected to think in terms of platforms first, translating complex investment domains into clean boundaries, contracts and abstractions that product teams can safely build on.

Nubank is also on a company‑wide journey to become anAI‑first company. We expect our senior engineers to be hands‑on with AI tools in their own work, and to help define how AI is used safely and productively in engineering and in products.

What we have to offer:

  • Own the technical direction of Investments Platforms – the systems that implement Nubank’s investments business model in software (custody, offer, orders, account, settlement and more) and power how we scale investments in Brazil and future markets.

  • Lead the migration off legacy Invest systems : design and execute strategies to move critical flows into modern Nubank platforms, while we continue operating at scale and meeting regulatory commitments.

  • Work on a disruptive investments architecture – rethinking how investments should be modeled and operated end‑to‑end, rather than just lifting and shifting existing broker or custodian patterns.

  • Drive AI usage in a high‑impact domain : help define how we use AI in investments – both in the products we ship and in how we design, build and operate platforms.

  • Collaborate across the platform ecosystem – working closely with other business and technical platforms such as Payments and Banking, and with product squads that consume Investments Platforms.

  • Global scope with hybrid flexibility : roles are based in Brazil, in a hybrid‑first model (office presence during the week plus periodic on‑site collaboration with other locations).

Core Qualifications (What We're Looking For)

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years working on large‑scale platforms or core systems in highly available, transactional environments (finance, payments, core banking, trading, etc.).

  • Proven track record building and operating business platforms that are extensible, multi‑tenant and domain‑agnostic – e.g., custody, payments, banking, risk or similar – with clear contracts for consuming teams.

  • Experience leading strategic migrations from legacy to new architectures: co‑existence patterns, strangler approaches, staged rollouts and data migration strategies that keep systems up while flows move off legacy.

  • Strong foundation in distributed systems and event‑driven architectures: domain modeling, consistency and resiliency strategies, backpressure, observability, SLIs/SLOs and incident learning loops.

  • Demonstrated platform engineering leadership at scale: defining reference architectures and RFCs, building reusable libraries and tools, setting platform SLAs, and making adoption low‑friction and high‑quality for internal customers.

  • Comfortable working as a horizontal leader across stakeholders: aligning GMs, PMs, EMs and Staff/Principals on trade‑offs between speed, risk, platform consistency and product goals.

  • Deep experience mentoring and multiplying senior engineers – raising the bar on architecture, design reviews, documentation and post‑incident retrospectives.

  • Investments expertise: hands‑on experience with investments platforms (brokerage, custody, order management, funds, fixed income, equities, settlement, risk) and understanding of the Brazilian capital markets landscape.

  • Platform background: prior work on other platforms (payments, core banking, investments) that shows you can design high‑abstraction, agnostic, extensible platforms and translate complex domains into clean boundaries and APIs.

  • AI fluency: you are already experimenting with AI in your engineering practice (design exploration, code generation/review, analysis, automation) and are excited to help Nubank push its AI‑first agenda in a pragmatic, safe way.

  • Language: Portuguese fluency is important; English is a plus rather than a hard requirement. We are open to strong IC8 candidates who can ramp up their English over time, and will trade off language in favor of outstanding technical and leadership fit where it makes sense.

  • Resilience and ownership mindset: you are energized by ambiguous, high‑stakes scenarios, keep a constructive and optimistic stance, and actively pull teams toward positive cultural change instead of getting stuck in pessimism or only in the micro level.

If you feel interested in these challenges and want to work on a highly engaged and talented team transforming how investments work in Brazil and beyond, this is the place for you!

What you’ll need to succeed

  • Minimum 7 years of experience from similar position

  • Previous experience with winches, cranes, steering gear is a must
  • Basic knowledge in both automation and/or electrical fields is a valuable asset
  • Proven experience working with computer systems professionally
  • Good English language - both verbal and written

Why MacGregor?

Our people are behind every success. People create the technology and product lifecycle solutions that make us great, our people are the ones who innovate, and people drive our business forward. With us you will be part of an international collaborative working culture with challenges and opportunities to further develop yourself professionally. We enable sustainable global maritime operations by maximizing efficiency in cargo and load handling.

  • Integrity steers all our thinking, behaviour and the relationships with our customers and other stakeholders

title: Lead
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform – including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses – 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world’s leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally , enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million , we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

Position Overview

We are looking for a talented and experienced engineering leader to join our team and lead the development of software solutions with both front-end and back-end components. Your team will be responsible for delivering products that support internal operations and drive our market-facing initiatives. You’ll be part of an international environment, working closely with cross-functional teams to shape and evolve our platform and digital experiences. We value teamwork and embrace a culture of ownership—our engineers are both autonomous and accountable for their deliverables. We are deeply customer-focused and committed to building software that creates real value for our users and the business.

Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and mentor a team of engineers, providing technical guidance and career development support.
  • Own the architecture and development of full-stack applications using React, Next.js, and Node.js.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers to translate requirements into actionable development tasks.
  • Oversee CI/CD pipelines, ensuring smooth deployments and high system reliability.
  • Design and implement scalable backend services leveraging AWS services.
  • Drive best practices in coding standards, code reviews, and system architecture.
  • Manage project timelines, prioritize tasks, and ensure on-time delivery.

Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Full Stack Engineer or similar role, with at least 2 years in a team lead or management capacity.

  • Revisar os Procedimentos Operacionais e Instruções de Trabalho sob a perspectiva da segurança do trabalho.
  • Manter organizado, de forma a ter rastreabilidade, os indicadores que suportam a cultura de segurança, como por exemplo apurando mensalmente a quantidade de horas destinadas a treinamentos de segurança, bem como quantidades e condições de incidentes e/ou acidentes (com afastamento e sem afastamento).
  • Suportar as demandas relacionadas ao controle de acesso da DFS.
  • Elaborar PPPs em atendimento as demandas internas e externas.
  • Atender ao programa corporativo de cultura de segurança, suportando no desenvolvimento do programa, desde a execução das atividades previstas até o registro das evidências.

Diferencial ter atuado em indústrias grau 3.

Manager, Workforce Communications & Engagement

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Working alongside the FIFA Zurich (FZ) Workforce Management team and reporting to the FIFA27 Head of Workforce, the Manager, Workforce Communications & Engagement is responsible for creating an unforgettable experience for all Staff at FIFA27 by providing a seamless and professional onboarding, a positive and engaging workplace environment, a rewarding and once in a lifetime Tournament and a simple but thorough offboarding journey.

This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament by retaining the FIFA27 Workforce and leaving a lasting positive impression so that FIFA continues to be the employer of choice for future Tournaments and events.

As the Tournament draws closer, this role will evolve from planning into workforce operations resulting in an assignment to a competition or non-competition location for the Tournament period.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage employee engagement/social activities and a communication plan to excite and engage all employees during their time with FIFA27.
  • Develop a strong working relationship with FIFA Zurich communications & engagement teams, and embed central FIFA initiatives and engagement programs into FIFA27.
  • Working closely with the Senior Manager, Recruitment & HR & HRBP’s to:
  • Generate ideas for embedding FIFA27 culture and values into the workplace environment
  • Partner on increasing employee satisfaction by implementing ideas based on employee feedback
  • Lead the workforce communications strategy, including the delivery of an ‘all-staff’ tournament workforce briefing prior to mass arrivals at tournament-time
  • In collaboration with the workforce operations, manage the strategy, planning and execution of a tournament-time workforce reward & recognition program across eight FWWC host cities.
  • Plan and execute the FIFA27 employee offboarding journey
  • Determine and manage the end-to-end onboarding processes from employment contract signature to the end of the new joiners first month, including the delivery of induction days and onboarding content.
  • Identify and manage the requirements and steps for relocation services for employees within Brazil and internationally.
  • Work closely with VISA & Immigration resources to determine processes for entry to Brazil in alignment with immigration requirements for international employees.
  • Establish mechanisms and collate detailed information regarding setting up ‘temporary life in Brazil’ to support international new employees with their relocation and settling into their new life in Brazil and their role with FIFA27.
  • Source, procure and manage distribution of new employee welcome packs in preparation for new joiner’s first day at FIFA27.

YOUR PROFILE

  • 5 years’ experience in a comparable role in an international, fast-paced environment, complex project, preferably in the events and/or sports industry.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Knowledge and demonstrated ability in event planning and event project management, prioritize effectively, and work independently.
  • Ability to provide examples where excellent client service skills and the capacity to facilitate the needs of multiple business units has served you well in your career to date.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrable adaptability and examples of where you’ve acted as a facilitator and/or negotiator.
  • Strong attention to detail, demonstrate initiative and a strong focus on providing a high level of service.
  • A team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and or multinational organization.
  • Fluent Portuguese, advanced or fluent English skills (written & spoken)

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
